$comment: Schema-of-state-machines for the RWP IDEA lifecycle. Validates the SHAPE of a lifecycle state-machine definition (states list, initial state, transition graph, optional per-state required-fields metadata). Per ACS-0038 KD-38.6, this schema validates structural shape and per-field enum membership only; cross-array consistency (initial_state must be a member of states; transition source/target keys must be members of states; required_fields_per_state keys must be members of states) is enforced by Level-3 rhumb-validate (ACS-0041), not by JSON Schema. Per ACS-0038 KD-38.6 reject, no if/then/else conditional required is used. State-name validation is delegated via $ref to idea.schema.json#/properties/status — that schema is the single source of truth for the 7-state enum, and any drift between the two schemas is detected by JSON Schema $ref resolution at compile time. Authored under MP-0288-idea-artifact (ACS-0038 / AVD-0009 OPEN-row inheritance: Apache 2.0).
title: RWP IDEA Lifecycle State Machine Schema
description: JSON Schema for the IDEA lifecycle state-machine definition consumed by the Rhumb Workflow Protocol (RWP). Describes the data shape of a state-machine specification: the set of valid lifecycle states, the initial state (entry point for newly captured IDEAs), the transition graph (per-state allowed targets), and optional metadata about which IDEA frontmatter fields are required when an IDEA is in a given state. Per KD-38.6, the required_fields_per_state map is metadata only — it does NOT condition idea.schema.json's required[] (which is unconditional); Level-3 rhumb-validate (ACS-0041) consumes this metadata to perform per-state required-field checks at runtime. Per KD-38.2, frontmatter is the source of truth on conflict with file location; this schema validates frontmatter-derived state-machine definitions, not file-system organization.

states.description: Lifecycle states. Each entry must be a valid IDEA status value as declared in idea.schema.json#/properties/status (the canonical 7-state enum). The single source of truth for state names is idea.schema.json; this schema does not redeclare the enum, it references it. Cross-reference validation (every state machine state appears at least once as a transition source or target) is Level-3 rhumb-validate territory.

initial_state.description: Entry point for a newly captured IDEA. Must be a valid status value (enum-checked via $ref to idea.schema.json#/properties/status). Cross-array check that initial_state is a member of states[] is Level-3 rhumb-validate territory; this schema only checks the value belongs to the canonical 7-state enum.

transitions.description: Transition graph. Keys are source states; values are arrays of allowed target states. Empty array means terminal (no outgoing transitions). Source keys and target values are both enum-checked via $ref to idea.schema.json#/properties/status. Cross-array checks (every key and every target appears in states[]) are Level-3 rhumb-validate territory.

additionalProperties.description: Allowed transition targets from this source state. Empty array marks the source as a terminal state (no outgoing transitions allowed).

required_fields_per_state.description: Optional metadata declaring which IDEA frontmatter fields MUST be populated when an IDEA is in a given state. Per KD-38.6, this is metadata only — it does NOT condition idea.schema.json's required[] (JSON Schema's required[] is unconditional and KD-38.6 explicitly rejects if/then/else for per-state required). Level-3 rhumb-validate consumes this metadata to perform per-state required-field checks at runtime. Keys are state names (enum-checked via $ref); values are arrays of frontmatter field names (free strings, intentionally not enum-restricted because the validator must tolerate state machines that reference custom IDEA extension fields).

additionalProperties.description: Frontmatter field names required by Level-3 rhumb-validate when an IDEA is in this state. Each entry is a free string matching an IDEA frontmatter property name (e.g., approved_by, promoted_to, parked_reason, discarded_reason).
